data.one_liner: Pure Dart SDK for Cloudinary API, enabling signed/unsigned uploads, deletes, and URL generation.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Cloudinary client that can upload files (signed or unsigned), delete single or multiple resources, and construct transformed image URLs. It supports progress callbacks and optional custom API URLs.
use_when: Uploading media to Cloudinary from a server or Flutter app
Managing Cloudinary assets (delete, list, transform URLs)
When you need a lightweight, pure Dart solution without UI widgets
avoid_when: You need a full-featured image editor or UI widget set
You are targeting a different cloud storage provider
strengths: Supports both signed and unsigned uploads
Pure Dart, works on all platforms
weaknesses: No UI components or image editing features
Requires API key/secret for signed uploads
data.setup_notes: Add cloudinary_sdk to pubspec, import, instantiate Cloudinary.full or Cloudinary.basic, then call upload/delete methods
